Israeli forces raided the Aqabat Jabr camp south of Jericho, the city of Qalqilya, the village of Kobar in the Ramallah district, and the town of Kafr Aqab north of Jerusalem, Al Jazeera reporters on the ground said.

Troops also stormed the town of Yabad alongside the villages of Zababdeh and Burqin in the Jenin governorate, while another raid targeted the village of Faroun south of Tulkarem.

item.title: [www.middleeasteye.net] NYT: Trump switched planes in Turkey over Iran threat
item.description:
NYT: Trump switched planes in Turkey over Iran threat

US President Donald Trump switched aircraft while leaving Turkey this month after US officials identified a credible threat from “Iranian proxies” targeting him and Air Force One, The New York Times has reported.

According to the newspaper, Trump had flown to Ankara for the Nato summit aboard a Qatari-donated Boeing 747-8, which lacks some of the advanced defensive capabilities of the older Air Force One aircraft.

After the threat emerged, the US Secret Service urged Trump to change planes before departing, the report said.

The New York Times, citing people briefed on the matter, said the intelligence suggested “Iranian proxy forces” were targeting Trump and whichever aircraft he was travelling in, rather than the new plane specifically.
